interpretation: Each inventory occurrence has an explicit decision, including accepted redundant boundary/traversal defenses. Disposition is not diagnostic suppression, numeric clearance, proof that every defensive path is reachable, or exhaustive runtime validation. Future source/tool changes require fresh inventory. The older 634 routing inventory is not relabeled as semantic review.

package-map.revisit_when: Recheck the producer invariant and existing behavior gates if the call chain changes.

mutable-wordpress-properties.reason: Each listed expression reads a WordPress-owned post, revision, comment, term/menu, query, user/role, taxonomy/post-type registry or screen object. Keep defaults/isset plus existing casts, sanitizers and permission checks. Some are redundant for an ordinary intact core object; retention is a boundary decision, not proof of a malformed production object or a new bug.

source_lookup: Identifier, function and decision-group indices are zero-based; decision_group_keys maps group indices to decision_groups. Recover the exact baseline expression with source_base + includes/<file without class-context suffix> + base_line; full file SHA-256 binds the source. Duplicate ordinal is one-based for the same file/line/rule. Full raw expressions/context are also preserved in ignored source-atlas.json. No diagnostic location or disposition is omitted.
